# src/planet/buildings/roofs.ts

[Source](../../../../../src/planet/buildings/roofs.ts)

OSM roof shapes applied to an already extruded building solid.

Supported tags are `gabled`, `hipped`, `skillion` and `pyramidal`. Anything else, a
non-rectangular eight-vertex footprint, or a rise of zero keeps the flat cap. Flat tops
still report their top faces so a tagged roof colour can paint them.
This runs while a map tile is generated, not in the render loop.

## Module dependencies

- `three`
- `../../math/frame/vectors.js`
- `../../math/solid/mesh.js`

## buildingRoof

[Implementation, line 23](../../../../../src/planet/buildings/roofs.ts#L23)

Replace the flat top of a building solid with the OSM roof shape.
Returns the same solid when the shape cannot be built.

## pyramidalRoof

[Implementation, line 132](../../../../../src/planet/buildings/roofs.ts#L132)

Pyramidal roof for a single star-shaped outline that has more than four corners.
Separate outer rings and courtyards cannot share one apex, so those solids are refused
and the caller keeps the flat cap.

```ts
pyramidalRoof(g: SolidGeometry, tags: Record<string, string>): RoofResult | undefined
```
